criteria.question: Does the architecture resolve program, residents, visitors, circulation and convergence as a coherent whole?
Does the proposal redesign the full plaza, respect Cerdà/Eixample scale, and preserve Sagrada Família visual primacy?
Are Gaudí's structural/logical principles used to solve real problems rather than copied cosmetically?
Is the AI workflow explicit, controlled and spatially coherent across plans, sections and 3D?
Does the design use credible passive ventilation, solar/thermal control and acoustic buffering?
Can the jury understand the thesis, architecture, evidence and workflow quickly from the A1 board?
